title: Security Assessment and Testing learning paths

fast.method: Define one assessment question, choose evidence and method, then write an executive conclusion.

standard.method: Study each unit and apply it to a small control-assessment program.

reinforcement.method: Contrast assessment, test, and audit from memory and critique a sample report.

completionEvidence: Can distinguish assessment, test, and audit
Can choose evidence and methods for a control question
Can report limitations, findings, risk, and remediation without overstating assurance
